Super grateful to have been able to learn here and will definitely continue into every further level they have! Highly, highly, highly recommended!

2.	Choreography Magic – I was amazed to see her perform a three-minute choreography with confidence and polish, achieved in just four sessions! The instructors’ ability to break down complex steps into simple, joyful learning is nothing short of brilliance.
3.	World-Class Faculty – The teachers are not only masters of their craft but also patient, inspiring mentors. Their passion radiates in every class and makes the students shine.

featured_reviews.name: Sarika Periwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shenvi School of Dance is an excellent choice for dance training. My daughter has been a part of this institution for over a year now, and here's what makes it stand high above other dance classes in my opinion....
1. The founders, Kiran Shenvi and his wife Varsha are deeply involved with the minutest details of how the school is run.
2. This is a proper "school" that teaches various forms of dance. It has a curriculum with levels, and children get promoted to higher levels as they learn the techniques and skills. It's not just about picking a song and dancing to it (though that's a part of it, of course), it's about learning various advanced dance techniques through every dance session, and then progressing to the next level.
3. Kiran Shenvi Sir is the heart and soul of the institution, and his passion for dance trickles down to the entire team of teachers. He personally teaches many classes, and is usually around to supervise other classes conducted by his team.
4. The entire team is very friendly and welcoming. It feels like home for the kids. They just love going to class.
5. The setup is preferable to other celebrity dance schools with branches all over, where it's highly unlikely you'll ever get to learn under the founding teacher.
6. Their studio is newly renovated with a wonderful ambience that makes you wanna dance.
7. My daughter's dance skills have greatly improved.
Overall, when I was looking for dance classes for my daughter over a year back and took some trials in my area, Shenvi School of Dance really stood out. And today, after a year, we're really happy we chose this school.

Thanks a ton Shenvi team❤️❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Forum Surti
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, I can’t say enough good things about Shenvi School of Dance. My daughter’s been going here for Jazzhop and Contemporary, and what I’ve seen in just a short span is nothing short of amazing. It's not just about dance steps or technique—this school genuinely brings out the best in each child.
What really sets it apart is the ethos behind it all. There’s a deep-rooted belief here that every child has something special within them, and the focus isn’t on who’s the flashiest or the fastest—it’s on helping each one grow at their own pace, in their own way. They don’t just teach movement—they nurture confidence, individuality, and joy.
Kiran Shenvi, the founder, is the real heart and soul behind it. His vision goes way beyond just skill or talent. He sees dance as a way for kids to express themselves, to grow emotionally and mentally, not just physically. He’s not interested in cookie-cutter dancers— he wants each child to shine in their light. And you can feel that energy the moment you walk into the studio.
There’s no pressure, no competition, just pure encouragement and passion. My daughter comes out of every class beaming—more confident, more free, and more in love with dance than ever before.
Shenvi School of Dance isn’t just a place to learn steps. It’s a space where kids find their voice, their rhythm, and their strength. Couldn’t ask for more and couldn’t be more grateful to have found SSD!

JUST PATHETIC AND INHUMAN.

featured_reviews.review_text:
There's a difference between things that are tolerable and ones which aren't. BUT.....
1. Workshop starting half an hour late...NO

3. Putting 55 to 60 people to dance where you can hardly move your hand without punching someone...BIGGEST NO
4.AC's kept on 24 with the room so overly crowded..PATHETIC
5. THEN in the name of a break keeping Half The class outside for almost 15 mins and the girls trying to come in saying that they are feeling hot if they cna just stand on the side...NO WORDS

People come to the Workshop to learn,have fun and sweat it out in the best way NOT LIKE THIS

Don't get me wrong the choreography is beautiful and got viral and sold out every Workshop for a GOOD REASON but people who are paying 1000 rupees to come learn it can't be treated like that.

The workshops are overpriced, overcrowded, and clearly more about making viral Instagram videos than actually teaching dance. There’s barely any space to move; they sign up far more people than the studio can accommodate. Most participants already know the choreography beforehand, so the instructor doesn’t really teach much during the session.

If you’re genuinely looking to learn or grow as a dancer, this isn’t the place. You’d probably have more space and freedom dancing in your kitchen. Total waste of money and time.

featured_reviews.name: Amritpal Singh Suri
featured_reviews.review_text: Dance planet is by far one of the best Dance classes especially for Social JIVE. The founder Lillian Mendes has a vast experience national as well as international. The most grounded instructor, keeps it simple and easy for learners to understand. Recently she has classes in Thane 2 places, Santacruz, Kandivali and Townside. If you are fond of Rocknroll and wanna learn Jive, Dance planet is the place to go.

featured_reviews.name: Stacey Dcunha
featured_reviews.review_text: Lillian is brilliant! She choreographed and taught my fiance and me our first dance for our wedding. Since we don’t live in the same country as Lillian, she held online classes for us and was extremely patient with us during the entire duration. Thanks to her, we danced to an English and Latin song perfectly. She is a lot of fun and can even make a non dancer learn to dance. Definitely recommend her to everyone looking to learn to dance especially for your big day.
